item.title: Hitoyoshi & the Kuma River — Guide
item.description: The Kuma River, flowing through the Hitoyoshi valley in southern Kumamoto, is renowned as one of the three fastest-flowing rivers in Japan, making it a superb destination for river activities. Its lively rapids and clear waters, set amid green mountains, are ideal for exhilarating white-water rafting trips in the warmer months, with guided tours suitable for beginners and families as well as thrill-seekers. The river is also famous for its traditional ‘kudari’ boat descents, in which passengers ride wooden boats steered by skilled boatmen down the current through the scenic valley — a more relaxed way to enjoy the river and its gorges.

item.title: Kuma River Rafting — Guide
item.description: The Kuma River, flowing through the Hitoyoshi valley in the mountains near the Kagoshima–Kumamoto border, is renowned as one of the three fastest-flowing rivers in Japan, making it a premier destination for river adventure. Its lively rapids and clear waters, set amid green mountains, are ideal for exhilarating white-water rafting trips in the warmer months, with guided tours suitable for beginners, families and thrill-seekers who paddle together through the rapids and calmer pools.
